inputs.text: [happily] Listen, Wex! Today [excited] we go all the way back to the very beginning. Before Earth even existed.
[curious] Before Earth? So what was there instead?
[playful][calm] A cloud. A huge cloud of dust and gas, spinning around the Sun, [softly] which was brand new too.
[amazed] A cloud… can that turn into a planet?
[warmly] It sure can. Little by little, all those grains of dust stuck together. [serious] Gravity did that: an invisible force [calm] that pulls everything toward the center.
[excited] The ball grew, and grew, and grew. [pauses] And deep inside, the heaviest metals sank all the way down: they formed the core, [amazed] Earth's burning-hot heart.
[curious] Does that time have a name?
[serious][calm] We call it the Hadean. [softly] It comes from Hades, the Greek god of the underworld, [calm] because Earth looked like a lava-filled underworld.
[gasps] Was there already water, at least?
[sad] Not yet. It was much too hot for that: [softly] volcanoes everywhere, and lava as far as you could see.
[calm] But Earth finally cooled down. [pauses] Slowly, over millions of years.
[happily][excited] Then it started to rain! [gasps] A huge rain, falling for a very very long time, filled up Earth's low places.
[warmly] That is how the very first oceans were born. [pauses] And it's in that water, Wex, [amazed] that the greatest adventure was about to begin.
